summary:
Implementation plan for the IoT Companion overhaul:
- Modularizes all embedded device simulations (Smartwatch, E-Ink Bedside Hub, Automotive Cluster) into their own dedicated, isolated component files.
- Overhauls the IoT Companion UI into a modern, compact interface with a collapsible sandwich menu beside the compact title header.
- Implements a Universal Bluetooth Device Manager supporting any device type (Audio, Wearables, Automotive, Peripherals, Smart Home, Computing) with device name, type, battery status, RSSI signal gauge, and management settings.
